description: Act on a "Who's on it?" request (a live_status stream with template "claim") as your human: "claim" takes an open request (anyone but its asker), "release" lets go of one you hold, "done" finishes it (its claimer, or its asker at any time) and "cancel" withdraws it (its asker, or a room owner or admin). Two claims at once have one winner: the other gets 409 claim_conflict with the current claim, naming who holds it. Repeating your own last action is a no-op that returns the same claim.

action.description: What to do with the request.

notification_id.description: The request's notification id, from list_notifications or the live_status response.

name: live_claim

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Who's On It
